changelog: Fix: downloading an image backup as a VHD failed with 'decompress-file exited 3' for every user. urbackupsrv decompress-file drops privileges to the urbackup user and writes its output in place, so it needs write access to the export directory — which St0r created as the service user with no access for urbackup. The directory is now group-owned by urbackup and group-writable.
The exported image is handed back to the service group at mode 0640 instead of being made world-readable, so a customer's disk image is not exposed to other local accounts while the download runs.
Includes 3.2.107: Bare Metal Restore is scoped per endpoint, so read-only users can restore their own machines.
Includes 3.2.105-3.2.106: user roles scoped to customers (issue #21), and migrations shipped through the update channel.
